newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Stg/mark pushes higher, capped at 3.05.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Stg/mark pushes higher, capped at 3.05.

text.p: Sterling has pushed higher against the mark in Europe and while building a base for further gains it is likely to remain capped around 3.05 marks, said chartists.
At 0845 GMT, sterling/mark was trading at 3.0451/61 against 3.0363 marks in late Europe on Monday.
"Sterling/mark is going upwards slowly...But it is beginning to run into a little supply as it comes into 3.05 marks," said Susan Rigg, senior technical analyst at Chart Analysis.
Rigg said sterling was likely to continue banging against that supply or resistance area. The 3.05 level needs to be breached for the pair to re-visit a chart top at 3.0878 marks.
